The Swiftest — SWF167 — Pet Insurance — Donation Matching

Pet Insurance Gurus · Convert exp 100052999 · Control 1000257732 · Variation 1000257733 (cre-t-167, "Donations") · Pages: /, /home/, /comparison/, /compare/ · QA 2026-10-26

72/88checks passed across 4 browsers/devices
18/22Chrome
18/22Edge
18/22Firefox
18/22Safari
8findings (2 high, 1 medium, 3 low, 2 questions)

Verdict: not ready to launch. The visual change and interaction match Figma on every browser and device: the Donations link, the new first FAQ, smooth-scroll + auto-open, and styling. Blocking: no goals are wired (BUG-01), so the test can't measure anything, and only 1 of the 4 copy variations exists in Convert (BUG-02). Also fix: the SWF144 FAQ stays open alongside the Donations FAQ (BUG-03). The failures are the same on every browser.

Findings

BUG-01HighVariation · all pages · all devices · tests: V16

None of the 3 custom goals is implemented: no click or FAQ-open conversion ever fires

The ticket lists three goals: Clicks on Donations Link, Clicks on See How Link and Donations FAQ opens (manually or by clicking on one of the links). The deployed variation code has no _conv_q.push(['triggerConversion', …]) call at all. Experiment 100052999 has only two goals attached. 100034508 is the site-wide "Outbound Partner Clicks – All Sources" goal (fired by experiment 100052764, not by this test). 100038337 is a code_trigger goal that nothing on the site triggers. A spy on _conv_q.push saw zero SWF167 conversions after a Donations click and after a manual FAQ open, on every browser. The test cannot measure its outcome as built.

Fix: Create the 3 goals in Convert, attach them to exp 100052999 (both arms), and fire them from the variation: in the Donations click handler _conv_q.push(['triggerConversion', '<donations-link-goal>']); in the FAQ toggle, when the item becomes active (both from the link and manually), _conv_q.push(['triggerConversion', '<faq-open-goal>']); and the same for the See How link once it exists (Q-01).

BUG-02HighConvert setup · tests: — (config), V15

Only one variation is built: V2 "Donate", V3 "Giving" and V4 "Help a Pet" are missing

The brief asks for four variations that differ only in the link copy (V1 Donations, V2 Donate, V3 Giving, V4 Help a Pet). Convert exp 100052999 has only control 1000257732 (50%) and one variation 1000257733 (50%), and its code hard-codes link.textContent = "Donations". Only one preview link was supplied. The other three copies were checked by swapping the label in place (V15). Layout is fine on every QA device, but see BUG-05 for 320px.

Fix: Add three more variations (or one shared code block with a per-variation label), set the split to 20/20/20/20/20, and share the force URLs so V2–V4 can be QA'd live.

BUG-03MediumVariation · all pages · all devices (needs SWF144 live, which it is) · tests: V09

Opening the Donations FAQ leaves the SWF144 "Vets love pet insurance" FAQ open: two answers expanded at once

If "Vets love pet insurance" (injected by the live SWF144 test) is open and the user clicks Donations in the header, or opens the new FAQ manually, both items stay expanded. Native FAQs are closed correctly (V08 passes). Cause: the close loop calls $active.find(".oxy-pro-accordion_header").trigger("click") for any item that is not a cre-t-167 item, but the SWF144 item's button is .cre-t-144-accordion_header with no oxy-pro-accordion_header class, so nothing is clicked.

Fix: Treat any injected item the same way as cre-t-167's own: if ($active.is(".cre-t-167-accordion_item, .cre-t-144-accordion_item")) { slideUp body; set aria-expanded=false; removeClass("active") } else { trigger native header click }. Alternatively, trigger click on $active.children("button").

BUG-04LowVariation · all pages · all devices · tests: V10

aria-expanded on the Donations FAQ gets out of sync (says "true" while closed, then "false" while open)

Open the Donations FAQ, then open any native FAQ. The site's handler closes the Donations item (removes active and slides it up) but leaves aria-expanded="true". On the next open, the variation toggles the attribute, so the open item now reports aria-expanded="false". This misleads screen readers. It is not visible.

Fix: Set the attribute from state instead of toggling: after $item.toggleClass("active") use $button.attr("aria-expanded", $item.hasClass("active") ? "true" : "false"). In openFAQ(), also check aria-expanded and active together.

BUG-05LowVariation · mobile ≤ 359px wide · tests: recon (320px)

6px horizontal scroll at 320px: "Donations" is wider than "Contact"

At 320px wide (iPhone SE 1st gen, small Androids) the header nav ul ends at 326px, so the whole page scrolls sideways by 6px. Control measures 311px with no overflow. Per copy at 320px: Donations 326, Help a Pet 326 (also overflows), Donate 308, Giving 302. Every copy fits at 360px and wider, so all QA devices (390–1440px) pass.

Fix: In the existing @media (max-width: 370px) block, reduce the nav item gap, e.g. html body .oxy-header-right nav li { margin-right: 6px !important; } (it is 10px now), or drop the font to 11px.

Q-01QuestionTicket / Figma · tests: V17

"See How" link has a goal but appears nowhere in Figma or code

Goal "SWF167 – Clicks on See How Link" and "…by clicking on one of the links" imply a second entry point (probably next to "We donate for every policy purchased" in the hero). Figma shows only the header Donations link and the FAQ, and the code builds nothing else. Please confirm where the "See How" link goes, with its copy and placement, or whether the goal should be dropped.

Fix: Client/designer to confirm. If needed, add the link and wire it to openFAQ("donations") plus its own goal.

Q-02QuestionVariation · FAQ list · tests: V02

Near-duplicate FAQ: native "We donate to animal welfare charities" is still in the list

The new first FAQ "We donate to animal welfare charities and match your gifts" repeats the topic of the existing native FAQ "We donate to animal welfare charities" (about 11th in the list). Figma doesn't say whether to keep or hide it.

Fix: Confirm with the client. If it should go, hide it in the variation only.

CLEAN-01LowvB.css / vB.js · tests: code review

Clone leftovers from SWF144 (no visual impact)

.cre-t-167-vetApprovedLink rules (3 blocks) target an element that doesn't exist in this test. The header rules (logo 350px at 991–1060px, nav li margin 10px ≤768px, 12px font ≤370px) duplicate SWF144's CSS: control and variation measure identically at 320/360/700/1000/1440px. .cre-t-167-accordion_header declares color twice. Like SWF144, the FAQ question is an <h4> inside a <button>, and the button has no aria-controls.

Fix: Remove the dead vetApprovedLink rules. Keep the header rules only if SWF144 may be switched off while this test runs.

What passes

  • Header: Contact → Donations, placed between How We Rank and About as in Figma, with the same font, size and colour as its neighbours (V01).
  • New FAQ is first in the list (above SWF144's "Vets love pet insurance"). Question and answer match Figma word for word. It is collapsed on load (V02, V18).
  • Closed FAQ styling is identical to the native items: font, weight, colour, padding, divider and icon size (V03).
  • Clicking Donations smooth-scrolls to the FAQ and auto-opens it: blue title (#0272E4), "+" rotated to "×", no #faq-donations in the URL. It works from the top and from the page bottom, with the question landing ~100–135px from the viewport top (V04, V05).
  • A second Donations click keeps it open. Manual open/close works. Opening it closes any open native FAQ (V06–V08).
  • Keyboard: the link is focusable and Enter works (desktop, V11). Re-running the code creates no duplicate FAQ, link or handler (V12). No page JS errors.
  • All four targeted URLs work: /, /home/, /comparison/ and /compare/ (V13). The nav stays on one row with no overlap with Prices and no sideways scroll on every QA device (V14). All 4 copy variants fit (V15).
  • Control keeps "Contact → /contact-us/" with no new FAQ (C01).

Notes

  • Deployed = local. The code in Convert (exp version 12) is byte-identical to local_testing/Local2/variation/vB.js / vB.css, apart from Convert's wrapper function.
  • Pre-launch settings to change: the audience is QA-only (cro_mode=qa cookie or query). Traffic is 50/50 across the only 2 arms. The location rule also includes /compare/, which is in the ticket title but not in the URL list. It works there too.
  • "Vet Approved" in Figma comes from SWF144, which is live in both arms on /, /home/ and /comparison/. On /compare/ SWF144 does not run, so the nav there is How We Rank · Donations · About. This is expected and not a SWF167 issue.
  • local_testing/Local2/variation/testdetail.md is stale (it describes SWF162 Life Insurance) and was ignored.
  • Console shows a few 403 resource errors on every page in both arms. These come from the site, not from this test.
  • Mobile Playwright runs (Pixel 5, iPhone 12) were stopped by the system for low memory and are not in the matrix yet. Mobile was still checked in Chromium recon: iPhone 12 render, a 320–1024px nav width sweep, and the Donations click on a mobile viewport. Re-run with --project="Mobile Chrome (Pixel 5)" / "Mobile Safari (iPhone 12)".
  • Not covered: real iOS/macOS hardware (Playwright WebKit used), V2–V4 as real Convert variations (they don't exist yet), and Convert reporting dashboards.

Expected values come from Figma and the ticket, not from the code. Failing tests are the defects above. "n/a" = not applicable on that device (keyboard on touch devices). "Details" holds measurements and failure messages.

Design reference

Scope and method

  • Order followed: Figma → vB.js/vB.css → deployed Convert code (extracted from window.convert.data, identical to local) → live force URLs → Playwright spec my-playwright-project/testing/swf167-donation-matching.spec.js → this report.
  • Browsers: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (WebKit) desktop at 1280×720, run one at a time (Pixel 5 / iPhone 12 runs pending, see Notes). Extra width sweep at 320/360/375/414/768/991/1024/1440px in Chromium (recon scripts in testing/swf167-recon/).
  • Covered: bucketing, nav swap (text, href, order, styling), FAQ injection (position, copy, default state, styling), link click from top and bottom, repeat click, manual toggle, interplay with native and SWF144 FAQs, aria state, keyboard, re-run/duplication, all 4 URLs, header layout and overflow, all 4 copy labels, goal firing (_conv_q.push spy), page errors, control unchanged.
